name: IfcOpenShell
what_it_does: IFC toolkit in C++ and Python, and the home of Bonsai, a Blender-based BIM authoring environment
caveat: Scripting knowledge helps a lot; the Blender interface is not a drafting package

name: web-ifc
what_it_does: WebAssembly IFC parser for the browser: geometry and properties at full speed
caveat: Parsing only; you bring the interface and the workflows

name: ThatOpen Components
what_it_does: Web components for viewing, measuring and coordinating IFC models in a browser
caveat: The successor to IFC.js and still moving; pin your versions

name: xBim Essentials
what_it_does: .NET toolkit for reading, writing and querying IFC
caveat: The .NET option; smaller community than IfcOpenShell

name: xBim Windows UI
what_it_does: Windows desktop IFC viewer, validation and model tools
caveat: Desktop .NET heritage; check the release cadence before depending on it

name: xBim WebUI
what_it_does: Web-based IFC model viewer from the xBim project
caveat: Viewer only; lighter maintenance than the desktop stack

name: BIMserver
what_it_does: Self-hosted IFC model server with revision control and notifications
caveat: Java, heavyweight, and the operational effort is real

name: BIMsurfer
what_it_does: Browser-based IFC viewer used by BIMserver
caveat: A viewer, not a coordination or clash tool

name: Bldrs Share
what_it_does: Browser IFC review and collaboration, with links you can share
caveat: Young project; validate against your own models first

name: Speckle
what_it_does: Open data platform that moves geometry and data between AEC tools
caveat: Server to run; check the licence for commercial hosting

name: LibreCAD
what_it_does: 2D CAD for drawing production
caveat: 2D only, and DWG support is weaker than DXF: convert first

name: QCAD
what_it_does: 2D CAD with a mature DXF/DWG engine
caveat: Community edition is GPL; some features are paid editions

name: ezdxf
what_it_does: Python library to read, write and automate DXF drawings
caveat: A library, not a CAD interface; excellent for drawing QA scripts

name: FreeCAD
what_it_does: Parametric 3D CAD with BIM, FEM and drawing workbenches
caveat: Real learning curve; a modelling tool rather than a construction platform

name: pdf.js
what_it_does: PDF rendering in the browser; the base layer of most web drawing viewers
caveat: Rendering and forms, not measurement or markup workflows

name: PyMuPDF
what_it_does: Fast PDF parsing, text extraction and manipulation in Python
caveat: AGPL for the free tier: check before embedding in a product

name: pdfplumber
what_it_does: Extracts text, tables and coordinates from PDFs
caveat: Text-based PDFs only; scanned sets need OCR first

name: Camelot
what_it_does: Pulls tables out of PDFs into dataframes
caveat: Merged cells and borderless tables defeat it

name: Stirling PDF
what_it_does: Self-hosted PDF toolbox: merge, split, stamp, OCR, redact, compress
caveat: General purpose; it knows nothing about sheets and revisions

name: Tesseract
what_it_does: The OCR engine behind most document digitisation
caveat: Accuracy collapses on stamped, folded, hand-annotated drawings

name: PaddleOCR
what_it_does: OCR with strong layout and table understanding
caveat: Model downloads and GPU expectations; keep documents in-house

name: Paperless-ngx
what_it_does: Scans, indexes and archives documents with tags and full-text search
caveat: An archive, not an EDMS: no transmittals, revisions or approval workflow

name: Mayan EDMS
what_it_does: Document management with metadata, versioning and workflow
caveat: Setup effort is high and the interface shows its age

name: BookStack
what_it_does: Wiki-style knowledge base for procedures and O&M documentation
caveat: Uncontrolled documentation: not a substitute for a document control system

name: OpenProject
what_it_does: Project management with Gantt charts, work packages, budgets and costs
caveat: Not a CPM engine: no float analysis or claim-grade schedule reporting

name: GanttProject
what_it_does: Desktop Gantt charting and critical path scheduling
caveat: Basic resource handling; not scaled to multi-job construction programmes

name: TaskJuggler
what_it_does: Text-based project planning with real resource levelling
caveat: Batch and syntax-heavy; you edit a plan file rather than a chart

name: OR-Tools
what_it_does: Google's optimisation toolkit, including CP-SAT for scheduling and sequencing
caveat: You supply the model; it is not a scheduling application

name: ODK Central
what_it_does: Self-hosted server for mobile field forms, submissions and exports
caveat: Not construction-aware: you design the forms and the workflow

name: ODK Collect
what_it_does: Android client for filling in ODK forms offline and syncing later
caveat: Android only; iOS needs a replacement in the field

name: KoboToolbox
what_it_does: Form builder and data collection platform with a mature offline story
caveat: The hosted service is the easy path; self-hosting is real work

name: OpenDroneMap
what_it_does: Turns drone imagery into maps, point clouds and 3D models
caveat: Needs good overlap and ground control; outputs still need QA against survey

name: COLMAP
what_it_does: Structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo photogrammetry
caveat: Research-grade interface; command line heavy

name: Meshroom
what_it_does: Photogrammetry with a node-based graphical interface
caveat: GPU hungry, and photogrammetry is not measurement-grade surveying

name: CloudCompare
what_it_does: Inspect, compare, measure and clean point clouds and meshes
caveat: Desktop tool with no project database or audit trail

name: Open3D
what_it_does: Point cloud, mesh and registration algorithms in Python and C++
caveat: A library, not an application; you build the workflow

name: PDAL
what_it_does: Point cloud data abstraction with pipeline processing
caveat: Format and pipeline plumbing rather than end user tooling

name: Potree
what_it_does: Web viewer for very large point clouds
caveat: Display and navigation only

name: laspy
what_it_does: Read and write LAS and LAZ point cloud files in Python
caveat: File format plumbing; pair it with something that analyses

name: QGIS
what_it_does: Desktop GIS used for site mapping, earthwork volumetrics and utility records
caveat: Not CAD: plan production and sheet setup are limited

name: GDAL
what_it_does: The geospatial translation and processing library under almost everything else
caveat: Command line and API only; unglamorous and everywhere

name: GeoServer
what_it_does: Serves map layers over OGC web services to browsers and apps
caveat: Java stack with real operational overhead

name: pyproj
what_it_does: Coordinate reference system transformations in Python
caveat: Choosing the wrong CRS is still your problem, silently

name: WhiteboxTools
what_it_does: Terrain, hydrology and raster analysis for earthwork and drainage
caveat: Terrain analysis focus; not a survey adjustment tool

name: COMPAS
what_it_does: Computational framework for structural geometry, analysis and fabrication
caveat: Python, research-flavoured, and its own learning curve

name: sectionproperties
what_it_does: Cross-section properties, stress and capacity calculations
caveat: Sections only, not whole-structure behaviour

name: PyNite
what_it_does: 3D frame finite element analysis in Python
caveat: Frame elements; it is not a design code checker

name: anaStruct
what_it_does: 2D frame and truss analysis with plotting
caveat: Two dimensions only; teaching to practice grade

name: OpenSees
what_it_does: Nonlinear structural analysis, widely used in earthquake engineering
caveat: Research-grade complexity and steeper than a frame tool

name: OpenSeesPy
what_it_does: Python interface to OpenSees for scripting analyses
caveat: The packaging and docs repository for OpenSeesPy; same complexity as OpenSees

name: EnergyPlus
what_it_does: Whole-building energy simulation, the reference engine in the field
caveat: Input files are unforgiving; garbage in, garbage out at scale

name: OpenStudio
what_it_does: SDK and tooling around EnergyPlus for modelling workflows
caveat: Version drift between SDK, GUIs and measures is a known pain

name: Radiance
what_it_does: Daylight and lighting simulation
caveat: Decades-old interface; script it or use it through Honeybee

name: Ladybug
what_it_does: Climate, sun, wind and comfort analysis from weather data
caveat: Grasshopper-centric in practice

name: Honeybee
what_it_does: Daylight and energy modelling built on Radiance and EnergyPlus
caveat: Needs Grasshopper or Python skill; not a design tool by itself

name: CoolProp
what_it_does: Thermophysical property database for HVAC and refrigeration calculation
caveat: A library; the engineering judgement stays with you

name: OpenFOAM
what_it_does: CFD for wind, smoke, ventilation and airflow studies
caveat: Specialist tooling: meshing, not modelling, is the hard part

name: openLCA
what_it_does: Life cycle assessment software, open source but distributed outside GitHub
caveat: Result quality depends on the database you licence, not on the software

name: Brightway
what_it_does: Python framework for life cycle assessment (Brightway 2.5)
caveat: Version churn is real: 2.5 and 2.x are not interchangeable

name: eemeter
what_it_does: Normalises meter data into energy savings figures
caveat: Aimed at utility programme evaluation rather than site work

name: ERPNext
what_it_does: Open ERP with projects, timesheets, purchasing and accounting
caveat: Not construction-native: no AIA billing, WIP schedule or retainage without customisation

name: Odoo
what_it_does: ERP with project, timesheet and analytic accounting
caveat: Community edition has no construction apps; licensing differs between editions

name: Tryton
what_it_does: Modular ERP with accounting, projects and timesheets
caveat: You build the construction layer yourself

name: Dolibarr
what_it_does: ERP and CRM for small organisations, with invoicing and projects
caveat: Job costing is thin for construction

name: GnuCash
what_it_does: Double-entry accounting for small businesses
caveat: No job costing at construction scale; fine for a tiny outfit only

name: Plane
what_it_does: Issue and project tracking with cycles and modules
caveat: Generic project tooling; no construction workflow built in

name: Vikunja
what_it_does: Self-hosted task and project lists
caveat: Lightweight by design; no scheduling or costing

name: Nextcloud
what_it_does: Self-hosted file sharing, document collaboration and office integration
caveat: File sharing, not document control: no transmittals or revisions

name: Outline
what_it_does: Team knowledge base for procedures and standards
caveat: A wiki; discipline still decides whether it stays current

name: Zulip
what_it_does: Threaded team chat, which suits project discussions better than channels
caveat: Operational effort to host; adoption is the real risk

name: Mattermost
what_it_does: Self-hosted team chat with file sharing and integrations
caveat: Ops burden, and the mobile app matters on site

name: ROS 2
what_it_does: Robot middleware: perception, navigation and control architecture
caveat: Robotics engineering, not construction work; the field is hard

name: Navigation2
what_it_does: Navigation and path planning stack for mobile robots
caveat: Assumes a known map and an engineered environment

name: LinuxCNC
what_it_does: Machine control for CNC fabrication equipment
caveat: Shop fabrication rather than site work

name: grbl
what_it_does: Motion control firmware for CNC machines
caveat: Firmware for hobby and small machines

name: Universal Gcode Sender
what_it_does: Sends G-code to CNC controllers
caveat: Shop tooling; not a production control system

name: OctoPrint
what_it_does: Web control for 3D printers
caveat: Prototyping and small-scale fabrication

name: Ultralytics YOLO
what_it_does: Object detection and segmentation; the usual starting point for PPE and progress detection
caveat: You must train on your own site imagery; published models do not transfer for free

name: Detectron2
what_it_does: Detection and segmentation toolkit from Meta AI
caveat: Research maintenance cadence; expect to pin versions

name: Segment Anything
what_it_does: Promptable image segmentation
caveat: Check the weights licence for commercial use before building on it

name: RoadDamageDetector
what_it_does: Road damage image dataset and detection baselines
caveat: One country's roads: treat it as a benchmark, not a trained model for your site
